questions.question_en: Why did you choose ATC as your career?
questions.question_cn: 为什么你选择管制作为你的职业？
questions.answer: Because I liked aviation and it's hard for me to be a pilot, I chose to be the eyes and ears for all the flights.

questions.question_en: What do you think of your present job?
questions.question_cn: 你对你现在的工作有何想法？
questions.answer: Because first, it pays me well, then, this job gives me a feeling of achievement, also, my family and friends respect me for I can handle the duty.

questions.question_en: Which air traffic control unit do you think is the most challenging one?
questions.question_cn: 你认为哪个管制单位是最有挑战性的一个？
questions.answer: I think the app control is the most challenging position. Because they need to deal with all the conflicts and provide sequencing service, app controller must think fast and work with both tower and area controllers.

questions.question_en: Is emergency evacuation needed after landing if the aircraft catches fire? Why?
questions.question_cn: 着火的飞机在落地后需要紧急疏散吗？为什么？
questions.answer: Yes, if the fire is still not under control after landing, the pilot will commence emergency evacuation, because there is risk of explosion or passenger injury.

questions.question_en: Do you often use English to communicate with pilots in your routine work?
questions.question_cn: 在你值班时，你经常用英语在波道里同飞行员通话吗？
questions.answer: Yes, we have some international flights in our airspace, we must use English to provide control services.

questions.question_en: Is it hard for you to communicate with pilots in English? Why?
questions.question_cn: 用英语与飞行员进行对话对于你来说是困难的吗？为什么？
questions.answer: I think standard English communication is easy, every controller should know how to deal with foreign pilots, but for emergency situation, English communication is a little bit difficult.

questions.question_en: How can a controller achieve effective communication in English with pilots?
questions.question_cn: 管制员怎样用英语与飞行员进行有效的沟通？
questions.answer: First, we should use standard communication terms, speak loudly and clearly. Then, we should monitor pilot readback. Also, if there is any problem, we should speak slower or twice, and confirm pilot's intention.

questions.question_en: In what way does ICAO language proficiency requirement contribute to flight safety?
questions.question_cn: ICAO英语熟练度的要求是怎样帮助大家改善飞行安全的？
questions.answer: First, this test and English requirement will drive us to learn the English communication, it will help us to reduce misunderstanding. Then, we will learn about some emergency situations, and the procedures that pilots may follow.

questions.question_en: Have you ever experienced or heard of misunderstanding in communication with pilots?
questions.question_cn: 你曾经经历过或听过与飞行员产生误解的事情吗？

questions.answer: There are many factors may lead to misunderstanding, such as strong accent, speak too fast, and using non-standard terms.

questions.question_en: As a controller, how can you avoid misunderstanding in communication?
questions.question_cn: 作为管制员，你是如何避免通讯中的误解的？
